hits.title: Vanzacaftor-tezacaftor-deutivacaftor in cystic fibrosis: 24-week results
hits.abstract: In this phase 3 trial, the vanzacaftor triple combination demonstrated non-inferior ppFEV1 improvement versus Trikafta with once-daily dosing. Sweat chloride reductions were sustained through 24 weeks; safety was consistent with prior CFTR modulators.

hits.title: Real-world outcomes of CASGEVY gene therapy in sickle cell disease
hits.abstract: A multicenter real-world analysis of exagamglogene autotemcel reported durable vaso-occlusive crisis elimination at 18 months, with engraftment kinetics consistent with the pivotal program.
